title: Ventura Protocol
tagline: Crowdsourced NFT wish-list, where anyone who pledges gets a % of the sale
description: An ability to share requests for NFTs, best ideas attract pledges, and when creator makes an NFT and sells it, every who pledged gets a reward percentage. Our aim is to keep frontend somewhat moderated and censored if needed, but the protocol to be rightly completely unrestricted.
how_its_made: Using Graph, Covalent for credit checks, Chainlink from the smart contract and Web3 storage for immutable content, with CID saved to smart contract Contract is deployed on Polygon. Credit check is done cross chain so that user doesn't have to move their funds just to make a pledge on Polygon.
